mutation CreateDatabase($name: String!, $databaseName: String, $databaseUser: String, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $plan: String, $version: String, $diskSizeGB: Int, $public: Boolean) {
  createDatabase(
    name: $name
    databaseName: $databaseName
    databaseUser: $databaseUser
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    plan: $plan
    version: $version
    diskSizeGB: $diskSizeGB
    public: $public
  ) {
    id
    name
    databaseName
    databaseUser
    plan
    status
    projectId
    environmentId
    __typename
  }
}
